Emergent Time Hypothesis

A research-grade section for an original theory.

The portfolio should treat ETH like a real investigation: evolving notes, milestones, mathematical development, and a publication path that respects scientific discipline.

Research Overview

Original investigation into the nature of time through mathematical reasoning and physics literature review.

Motivation

A desire to work through an unresolved question instead of only reading about it.

Core Questions

What is time? Is it emergent? Can a consistent mathematical model be built?

Current Progress

Reading, comparing literature, and building the proof structure in parallel.

Future Publication

Planned as a formal research paper after the draft reaches a stable shape.
